title: Warm White Indian Yogurt Lassi
description: A fatty and light Indian dish featuring a creamy yogurt lassi served with toasted ciabatta, this recipe is a unique and indulgent treat. It is kosher-friendly and served on a cedar plank.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the ciabatta into 1 inch thick slices and place on a cedar plank.
Drizzle the ghee or oil over the ciabatta slices and toast in the oven for 5 minutes.
In a blender, combine the yogurt, honey, cardamom powder, water, and salt, and blend until smooth.
Remove the ciabatta from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the warm ciabatta slices with the yogurt lassi.
Garnish with dried mint leaves and serve immediately.
Dehydrate any leftover ciabatta slices in a low temperature oven to make crispy croutons.
Store the croutons in an airtight container for up to 2 days.
